items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: And Yank Arthur Thomas, that's Buddy, Arthur Johnson, that's Buddy Johnson's brother. He was young like I was. Several other fellas. I used to play alto over there.

ctx.x: Who was in that band? Alan and a fella right in the M.O. Two Sweet, he was a carnage player. Alan and a man. And Yank Arthur Thomas, that's Buddy, Arthur Johnson, that's Buddy Johnson's brother. He was young like I was. Several other fellas. I used to play alto over there. Alan was playing cornet itself. I couldn't play enough cornet to play any bands, so they put me on the alto. Man I had one of them little upright alto that fell about that high, you know. Just making the chords, you know. And every time I'd get…
Did he play any fun with his band?
